audit.proof_assessment: No execution proof was supplied. Remediation was checked only against the allowlisted diff: page init uses researchConfigurationForCapability(false) and enables Refero only after a boolean capability confirmation; ledger empty-state predicates treat references-only as non-empty and render competitors, market expectations, differentiation, and client artifact relationships; source/competitor hrefs pass through safeExternalHref; Firecrawl copy is present; pipelineStatusLabel maps paused/complete/error. Unit tests cover those helpers/markup but are not an executed authority.
residual_risks: Capabilities fetch failures stay silent and fail closed; a slow or flaky /api/capabilities leaves Refero off until confirmation.

safeExternalHref allowlists http(s) via URL.protocol but returns the raw string, and EvidenceWorkspace tests only forbid href="javascript: — other non-http(s) schemes are implementation-blocked, not oracle-locked.
pipelineStatusLabel is unit-tested, but page wiring depends on pre-existing latestPipelineEvent; a later non-terminal timeline item would show { building } after a replayed terminal event.
No page-level test locks fail-closed initial research state; only intakeRequest helpers are asserted.
Business-lane helper text says the lane runs only with paid Firecrawl, while the status line says only competitor discovery is skipped.
